title: Chvátal-Gomory Rounding of Eigenvector Inequalities for QCQPs
summary: We introduce and analyze a class of valid inequalities for nonconvex quadratically constrained optimization problems (QCQPs) which we call Eigen-CG inequalities. These inequalities are obtained by applying a Chvátal-Gomory (CG) rounding to the well-known eigenvector inequalities for QCQPs, and transferring binary-valid inequalities to the continuous setting via a result of Burer and Letchford (2009).
